stem: Meena will receive Rs 1,21,000 at the end of 2 years. The annual discount rate is 10% compounded annually. What is the present value of this amount? [Use: (1.1)² = 1.21]

per_option_rationale.rationale: Student discounts for only 1 year: PV = 1,21,000 / 1.1 = 1,10,000, using n = 1 instead of n = 2.
Student does not discount at all and treats the future amount as the present value.
Student subtracts 10% twice as simple deduction: 1,21,000 - 2 × 11,000 = 99,000, confusing discounting with subtraction.

explanation: Present value = Future value / (1 + r)^n. With FV = 1,21,000, r = 0.10, n = 2: PV = 1,21,000 / 1.21 = 1,00,000. Discounting only one year gives 1,10,000, a common error when n is misread.
